A Dispatch server holds the reports of faults, each with its key. Two landings of earlier units stand on main. A script runs the query that gives the set of the person's decisions up to the stated date, and lists each decision that no statement states and no reason excuses. The coverage instrument lists each part of the code that no check runs, and a reviewer that did not write The Spec judges that list.
